decision.text: The brief's cause is slightly off: the message came from a SECOND Servex boot (17:34:01) five seconds after the agent was spawned by the first (17:33:56), not from a sweep that runs on a delay: Agents.revive() is synchronous at boot. So the rule is: skip an agent with no completed turn and no session file (it cannot be resumed), and one that started after this boot; mark the first gone, log revive-skip once. Narrowed from 'zero turns' to 'zero turns AND no session file' so a long first turn that did leave a session still gets revived and told.
decision.alternative: A longer boot delay before the sweep
decision.why_not: A delay still races a spawn: any restart can land seconds after any spawn, whatever the delay.
